recalibration.label: PART A: live recalibration (shadow until the day-34 decision)
recalibration.amendment: 2026-11-10 (evaluation pulled from graded day 21 to day 20 by CEO order after the day-20 diagnostic had been viewed; one-time, spent)

in_sample.note: in-sample, information only; the decision is the days 21-34 validation

validation.clock: day 23 graded; validation reads days 21-34; decision at day 34
validation.ship_condition: per stat: log loss of the map applied to p_raw beats the log loss of the currently shipped p on the graded rungs of days 21-34, paired difference (shipped - mapped) > 0 with the 95% player-game cluster-bootstrap CI excluding 0; otherwise the map is dropped for that stat and the result goes to data/failure_log.jsonl. No partial ship, no ship on the fit.

method: Trigger: band gap per stat over graded days 1-20 with the grader's player-game cluster bootstrap; a stat refits only if its own CI excludes 0.
Refit: isotonic (pool-adjacent-violators) of hit on the engine's raw p over days 1-20, one map per qualifying stat; logged in shadow as p_recal next to p_raw; picks and display keep the shipped p.
Validation: days 21-34 only, games the refit never saw; shipped p vs the map on p_raw, paired log loss, CI excluding 0; the interim table is information, the decision is read once at day 34.
Ship = the map written into data/ladder_calibration.json for that stat (previous maps kept under history); drop = data/failure_log.jsonl entry. Never a partial ship, never a ship on the fit.

minutes_sim.label: PART B: minutes-uncertainty engine (shadow; pre-registered evaluation)

fit_window.source: data/fp_log.csv last pre-tip projected minutes per player-game vs data/player_games.csv minutes; players who played; projected >= 4

sigma.source: data/v2_rows_2024.csv.gz (2023-24 walk-forward of the v2 engine, players who played, projected minutes >= 4)

registration.rows: graded rungs with shipped P in [0.55, 0.80) dated 2026-11-10 or later that carry a last-pre-tip shadow p_minsim (rows logged live by `shadow`, plus the 2026-11-10 rows backfilled from the committed pre-tip projections.json builds, flagged backfill=1), ordered by date, tip, event_id, player_id, stat, rung; the first n are the evaluation, read once when n is reached
ship_if: band log loss of p_minsim < band log loss of the shipped p on those n rows, paired difference (shipped - minsim) with the 95% player-game cluster-bootstrap CI (2,000 resamples, seed 20261023) excluding 0
|mean p_minsim - hit rate| < |mean shipped p - hit rate| on the same rows (the band gap moves toward 0)
registration.pooled: the decision is pooled over the four stats (one engine change, one version); per-stat numbers are reported, never used to ship a subset
registration.power: about 143 band rungs grade per day (2,854 over days 1-20), so n = 2,000 is about 14 graded days, the length of Part A's validation window; with a per-rung log-loss difference sd near 0.08 and a design effect near 1.7 (rungs per player-game) the 95% half-width at n = 2,000 is about 0.0045 nats, and removing a +0.07 gap on half the band (PTS) is worth about +0.006 nats pooled
registration.freeze: Part B may not ship before Part A's validation window (graded days 21-34) closes; a read at n before then is recorded and held, never re-read
registration.evaluated_quantity: p_minsim_cal = the convolved raw probability passed through the probability layer the engine ships at snapshot time (today the 2024-25 isotonic maps adopted under ladder_v2_rule.md; the shadow log records which layer was applied). The sim changes, nothing downstream of it does. The unmapped p_minsim is logged and reported as information only
registration.compares_against: the shipped p as logged at the time (raw engine through the 2024-25 maps today; if a Part A map ships at day 34 the later rows carry it, so Part B is judged against the then-current engine, never stacked blindly)

evaluation.clock: 343 of 2000 pre-registered band rows graded from 2026-11-10
evaluation.freeze: Part A validation open until graded day 34; no Part B ship before then

method: Shadow engine: each rung's probability integrated over the empirical minutes-error distribution (starter / bench, fit Oct 23 - Nov 9 only) with the minutes-conditional sigma measured on the 2023-24 walk-forward, then through the adopted maps like the shipped raw; rates, priors, blend, maps and grading untouched.
Evaluation: graded band rows from 2026-11-10 forward only (the fit saw Nov 3-9); n pre-registered before the window opened, read once at n; interim numbers are information, never the decision.
Ship only if band log loss improves with the cluster CI excluding 0 AND the band gap moves toward 0; otherwise the failure log. No ship before Part A's validation window closes.
